zh: 导航换了形态：侧栏收起时不再是一条压窄的深色板，而是一枚浮在槽位里的胶囊；手机上向下滑动页面，满宽的底栏也会折叠成同一枚胶囊，滚回顶部或切换页面就展开。折叠是一段 420ms 的连续形变——宽度、圆角、投影、标签高度一起走，不是两帧之间硬切。底栏顺带换成了浅色纸面材质，收缩后页面内容会从胶囊底下继续延伸，不再有那条挡住页面的横条。桌面侧栏展开态仍是深石色，和纸面形成原来的对比。
en: The navigation has a new shape. Collapse the sidebar and it is no longer a narrowed dark slab but a capsule floating in its slot; on a phone, scrolling down folds the full-width bar into the same capsule, and scrolling back up or switching pages unfolds it. The fold is one continuous 420ms morph — width, corner radius, shadow and label height move together, instead of a cut between two frames. The phone bar also turned into light paper, and the page now continues underneath the capsule rather than being blocked by a strip. The desktop sidebar still keeps its dark stone when expanded, so the contrast with the paper is unchanged.
